question: Among events with an 'Advertisement' budget line, find those where the spent amount exceeds the average spent across all Advertisement budget lines, and compute the percentage of these events that went over their total budget (i.e., have any budget category with remaining < 0).

prediction.sql:
WITH adv_avg AS (
    SELECT AVG("XCL_005") AS avg_spent
    FROM "budget"
    WHERE "XCL_004" = 'Advertisement'
),
qualifying_events AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT "XCL_009" AS event_id
    FROM "budget"
    WHERE "XCL_004" = 'Advertisement'
      AND "XCL_005" > (SELECT avg_spent FROM adv_avg)
),
over_budget_events AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT "XCL_009" AS event_id
    FROM "budget"
    WHERE "XCL_006" < 0
)
SELECT CAST(COUNT(DISTINCT ob.event_id) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(DISTINCT q.event_id) AS percentage
FROM qualifying_events q
LEFT JOIN over_budget_events ob ON q.event_id = ob.event_id

    FROM "budget"

FROM qualifying_events q

auxiliary_raw_evidence_draft.base_sql:
WITH ad_budgets AS (
    SELECT 
        b.XCL_009 AS event_id,
        b.XCL_005 AS spent,
        b.XCL_006 AS total,
        b.XCL_006 - b.XCL_005 AS remaining
    FROM budget b
    WHERE b.XCL_008 = 'Advertisement'
),
avg_spent AS (
    SELECT AVG(spent) AS avg_spent
    FROM ad_budgets
),
over_avg_events AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT event_id
    FROM ad_budgets
    WHERE spent > (SELECT avg_spent FROM avg_spent)
),
over_budget_events AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT b.XCL_009 AS event_id
    FROM budget b
    WHERE b.XCL_006 - b.XCL_005 < 0
)
SELECT 
    CAST(COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN obe.event_id IS NOT NULL THEN oae.event_id END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(DISTINCT oae.event_id) AS percentage
FROM over_avg_events oae
LEFT JOIN over_budget_events obe ON oae.event_id = obe.event_id
